subject: planner: merge fast plan cache and normal plan cache (#53143)
summary: This commit removes the ad-hoc cached PointGet plan/hints stored on `PlanCacheStmt` (`stmt.PointGet.Plan`/`ColumnNames` and `PointGetPlan.stmtHints`) and relies on the normal session plan cache (`PlanCacheValue`) for cached-plan hits. As a result, PointGet cached-plan reuse now goes through the standard safety gates (privilege re-check, dirty-table/UnionScan invalidation, matchOpts checks) and restores statement hints from `PlanCacheValue` rather than from a PointGet-specific field. Reviewed the diff vs first parent plus minimal surrounding callers (plan cache hit/miss path and prepared PointGet executor short-path reuse) and found no remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege, concurrency, or transaction/session issues in this change; later history on `upstream/master` for the touched files did not indicate an unfixed high-severity regression attributable to this commit.
